title: "Debian’s buildd Network"
---

# Debian’s buildd Network

Debian maintains one of the largest and longest-running distributed compilation fleets in the history of computing: the **`buildd`** (Build Daemon) network.

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|                   Debian's buildd Architecture            |
|                                                           |
| Maintainer uploads Source Package (.dsc + .orig.tar.xz)   |
|                         |                                 |
|                         v                                 |
|                   Archive Master                          |
|                         |                                 |
|                         v                                 |
|               Wanna-Build Database                        |
|  (Tracks build states: Needs-Build, Building, Uploaded)   |
|                         |                                 |
|      +------------------+------------------+              |
|      |                  |                  |              |
|      v                  v                  v              |
| buildd worker       buildd worker      buildd worker      |
| (x86_64 node)       (arm64 node)       (riscv64 node)     |
|      |                  |                  |              |
|      v                  v                  v              |
|  [ sbuild: Isolated chroot clean build using schroot ]    |
|      |                  |                  |              |
|      +------------------+------------------+              |
|                         |                                 |
|                         v                                 |
| Compiled .deb uploaded -> Incoming queue -> Archive Pool  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
```

## `wanna-build`: The Central Scheduler

The heart of Debian's infrastructure is `wanna-build`. It tracks package dependencies across architectures:
- When a source package is accepted into Debian `unstable`, `wanna-build` inspects its `Build-Depends` list.
- If all required development libraries for architecture `arm64` are already present in the archive, the package state moves to **`Needs-Build`**.
- If a required library is missing or currently being compiled, the package state transitions to **`BD-Uninstallable`** (Build-Depends Uninstallable) and waits automatically.

## `sbuild`: Clean Chroot Builds

When an idle worker node picks up a build task:
1. It launches **`sbuild`**, which creates an isolated LVM snapshot or tarball chroot.
2. It parses the source package's `debian/control` file and executes `apt-get install` to install *only* the specific packages declared in `Build-Depends`.
3. It compiles the package as an unprivileged user (`buildd`).
4. Upon completion, the entire chroot is destroyed.
5. The resulting `.deb` binaries, build logs, and `.buildinfo` metadata are cryptographically signed and uploaded back to the central archive.
